about.title: About the Shaarei Mordechai Kollel Network
about.body:
The Shaarei Mordechai Kollel Network was founded and operates in memory of the holy kabbalist Rabbi Mordechai Sharabi zt"l, under the leadership of Rabbi Refael Refaeli shlit"a, who grew up in the Rabbi's home and drew from his Torah from his youth.

The network runs kollelim and learning programs in Jerusalem and Bnei Brak, where Torah scholars (avreichim) toil in Torah study throughout the day and night, from a full-day kollel to the Chatzot (midnight) Kollel, which learns in the depths of the night while the world sleeps. Alongside the kollelim, the institutions offer public Torah classes and acts of kindness, continuing the path of our Rabbi zt"l: Torah, prayer, and helping a fellow Jew in his hour of need.

Every hour of study in the network is learned in memory of our Rabbi, and for the merit of our donors and those they support.

activities.title: Our Kollelim
activities.intro: Kollelim and learning programs in Jerusalem and Bnei Brak, where Torah scholars toil in Torah study throughout the day and night.

כולל יום שלם.title: Full-Day Kollel
כולל יום שלם.text: Torah scholars who sit and toil in Torah all day long, from morning until evening, with consistency and diligence.

כולל חצי יום, שכונת סנהדריה, ירושלים.title: Half-Day Kollel, Sanhedria, Jerusalem
כולל חצי יום, שכונת סנהדריה, ירושלים.text: A half-day learning program in the heart of the Sanhedria neighborhood, for scholars who devote half of each day to Torah.

כולל אחר הצהריים.title: Afternoon Kollel
כולל אחר הצהריים.text: Afternoon learning for Torah scholars and working men who wish to add hours of Torah later in the day.

כולל חצות.title: Chatzot (Midnight) Kollel
כולל חצות.text: Scholars who rise in the middle of the night for Tikkun Chatzot and Torah study while the world sleeps, in the way of our Rabbi zt"l.

כולל יום שישי.title: Friday Kollel
כולל יום שישי.text: Learning on Erev Shabbat, so that Friday is never void of Torah, and to enter Shabbat out of words of Torah.

כולל ליל פורים.title: Purim Night Kollel
כולל ליל פורים.text: A special learning session on the night of Purim, the night the king's sleep was disturbed and Israel's salvation began, Torah, prayer and merits, so that the joy of Purim is never void of Torah.

כולל שכונת מקור ברוך, ירושלים.title: Mekor Baruch Kollel, Jerusalem
כולל שכונת מקור ברוך, ירושלים.text: A kollel in the Mekor Baruch neighborhood, serving as a place of Torah and prayer for residents of the neighborhood and its surroundings.

כולל בני ברק.title: Bnei Brak Kollel
כולל בני ברק.text: The network's branch in the Torah city of Bnei Brak, where scholars learn with diligence as part of the Shaarei Mordechai network.

/news/rav-salim-chizuk.title: Strengthening the world of Torah: Rabbi Avraham Salim delivers a chizuk talk to the kollel scholars
/news/rav-salim-chizuk.summary: Rabbi Avraham Salim shlit"a, member of the Council of Torah Sages and Rosh Yeshiva of Meor HaTorah, visited the kollel and delivered a talk of encouragement and inspiration to its scholars.

/news/rh-kit-2026.title: Holiday gift packages for the kollel scholars ahead of Rosh Hashana 5787
/news/rh-kit-2026.summary: Ahead of Rosh Hashana 5787, every scholar in the kollel network received a generous holiday package, wine, honey and shopping vouchers, in appreciation of their Torah study, across all eight kollel programs in Jerusalem and Bnei Brak.

/news/rav-amar-shiur.title: What is the halacha regarding processed meat? The Rishon LeZion captivates the kollel scholars in a special shiur
/news/rav-amar-shiur.summary: During his visit, the Rishon LeZion delivered a comprehensive and in-depth halachic shiur to dozens of scholars on the topic of processed meat and its halachic implications, laying out the foundations of the subject and its halachic aspects…

/news/chatzot-opening.title: An impressive ceremony in Jerusalem: the Chatzot Kollel inaugurated under Rabbi Refael Refaeli shlit"a
/news/chatzot-opening.summary: With the participation of leading Torah figures, rabbis and public figures, the opening ceremony of the Chatzot Kollel, the eighth kollel in the Shaarei Mordechai network, was held in Jerusalem.

/news/chanukah-oil-2025.title: Distribution of olive oil and a Chanukah shiur for the kollel scholars
/news/chanukah-oil-2025.summary: Ahead of Chanukah, the scholars of the kollel network gathered for a special shiur on the laws of Chanukah, after which each scholar received olive oil for lighting the Chanukah candles at home, a tradition of the kollel.
